notes: Installed Carmen at full price on T2 with no run first, so it got no discount and left the Runner at 0 credits. On T5-T6 the Runner clicked for credits up to 10 with a full grip instead of hitting Server 1, which let Post-Truth Dividend be scored on T7. Sable's mark was almost never run (T1-T6, T13-T16 passive), and T9-T10 went entirely into tag removal down to 0 credits. Won late off HQ/remote steals.

Strong R&D pressure with The Price/Cookbook and a quick win. T3 was a passive credit turn with no run, so Hoshiko flipped back for nothing. On T5 the Runner ran HQ instead of the 2-advanced card in Server 1, which became Fujii Asset Retrieval, but that was arguably fine.

Spent T5-T6, T8-T10 and T12-T15 clicking 4 credits a turn (up to 28) while holding 5 unplayed cards. Gauss could clear the known Server 2 ice, yet the Runner let Oracle Thinktank (T9) and two Remastered Editions (T13, T15) be advanced and scored there. Ended T24 with a tag after seeing Backroom Machinations on T17, and the Corp used it to win at 6 points. T24 also re-ran into F2P/Funhouse instead of paying 4 to avoid a tag.

After bouncing off Tatu-Bola on T2 the Runner never contested Server 1 again, even with 11-17 credits while the Corp sat at 0-3 credits. Flower Sermon (T7), two Project Yagi-Udas (T10, T12) and Hybrid Release (T14) were all scored there. T8-T11 were spent clicking credits and installing economy, and T13's HQ run with Devil Charm hit La Costa Grid instead of the remote.

Ran into an unbroken Doomscroll on HQ on T7, T8, T9, T11, T12, T14, T15 and T16 while sitting on 10+ tags. The 2-tag subroutine fired every time and binned about 20 cards, including Carmen, Sure Gambles and Masterwork, and Afterimage (installed T12) was never used to break it. Tags were left to pile up all game until a few pointless removals on T16-T17. The Corp, at 46 credits, then won on T18 with Shipment from Vladisibirsk.

Repeatedly re-ran unchanged R&D in the same turn and saw the same top card: 4 times on T2 and T3, 3 times on T4 and T5, twice on T11. On T2 those clicks should have gone to the advanced card in Server 1 (Project Yagi-Uda, scored T3). Face-tanked 4 net damage through Karunā on T4 for Flower Sermon. Won on T12 off a broke Corp.

Pressured R&D through Vasilisa every turn, and stealing there won the game. Re-installed Daily Casts on T10 while tagged, so the Corp trashed it on T11. Drew into a full grip on T9, and never installed a breaker or ran HQ after T1 despite holding 8-11 credits.

On T4 the Runner had 6 credits and declined to pay 3 on Grubber's ETR to reach the advanced Artificial Cryptocrash. On T13, with 32 credits, it declined to pay 1 on Paywall. From T5 to T17 it clicked credits up to 47 with 5 cards never played, while Kingmaking (T8) and two Remastered Editions (T13, T18) were scored from barely iced remotes. Unity was never used.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn from T5 to T18, ending at 61 credits with a full grip. The only runs were Server 1 on T4 and Archives on T11. Lotus Haze (T9), Longevity Serum (T11), Hybrid Release (T16) and Sisyphus Protocol (T19) were advanced openly in Server 3 and never contested. Bladderwort was never trashed.

Slow T1-T3: clicked for credits and facechecked Hafrún on HQ with no breaker. On T5 the Runner drew 3 instead of hitting the unprotected Archives right after Longevity Serum, but the next turn's Archives run won the game with Fermenter money.

Good early R&D pressure and a clean Chastushka HQ sabotage into an Archives steal for the win on T6. T5 was passive with 14 credits, and the three naked remotes installed on T1, T2 and T4 were never checked.

Won by grinding R&D through Vasilisa against a Corp stuck at 0-2 credits. The Runner took a tag on every run and spent many clicks and credits removing them (T5, T8-T11, T15). Rigging Up put Living Mural on Capacitor on T13, but HQ was never run again, and Unity/Gauss were never used to break Vasilisa.

Clicked credits on T2-T5, T7, T9, T11 and T16-T17, reaching 28 credits without ever installing a breaker for Hafrún. As a result, See How They Run (T10, T12) and Lotus Haze (T18) were scored from Server 3 unopposed. On T10 and T12-T14 the Runner re-ran unchanged R&D 3-4 times a turn, seeing the same card.

From T1 to T12 the Runner poured every credit into 2-credit tag removals and ended most turns at 0-3 credits, so it never built a rig. Sable's mark was rarely run. Server 2 was left alone on T8 while installing Carmen at full price (Tomorrow's Headline scored T9). From T15 to T20 it clicked credits up to 23 with 5 cards in hand while Witch Hunt was advanced in Server 5 and won the game on T21.

Carmen broke Starlit Knight for 2 on T7, yet on T10, T11, T12 (with 10 credits) and T14 the Runner let it fire for 2 tags and ETR each time. The tag pile let Freedom of Information be scored at zero advancements on T14. Even after that, T17 went into Archives taking 2 Increased Drop Rates tags, and the next turn FoI was scored from hand for the win.

No coherent plan: the Runner clicked for credits every turn from T2 to T12, reaching 55, and made one Archives run all game. Hoshiko's flip was never used. Three Hybrid Releases (T6, T7, T9) and Sericulture Expansion (T12) were scored from naked or one-ice remotes, and the Runner won only because the Corp decked.

Gauss kept HQ open and Beatriz plus the double HQ run on T17 closed out the game. Spent 3 credits on T5 putting Living Mural on an empty remote's ice. T11 and T16 were pure credit clicks with no run, and T6 and T8 drew into hand-size discards.

Clicked credits from T2 to T9, reaching 42 with 5 cards never played. Sericulture Expansion (T5), Project Yagi-Uda (T7) and Hybrid Release (T9) were scored from remotes installed the turn before and never run. On T11 the Runner re-ran unchanged R&D three times, and on T12 it ignored advanced Server 2 (Sericulture scored T13).

Good aggressive play: took the HQ steal through Phoneutria, broke into Server 1 with Odore/Utae on T5, and won on T8 with R&D steals. On T8 Devil Charm was spent on Phoneutria but nothing was then broken, so the Runner still took 2 net damage.

Re-ran unchanged R&D 4 times on T2. From T7 to T11, at 0 credits, the Runner ran HQ 4 times a turn through Vasilisa, taking a tag each time and seeing the same Hype Machine/Daily Quest. That fed Vasilisa's advancements into the Server 4 Artificial Cryptocrash (T8) and fueled two Backroom Machinations (T7, T10). Spent T12-T15 on 2-credit tag removals while the Corp scored Oracle Thinktank and Kingmaking.
